summary: feat(settings): update reset password start page copy for passkeys
description:
## Because

- The first password reset screen did not tell users that they can sign in with Google, Apple, or a passkey instead.

## This pull request

- Changes the heading to "Forgot your password?" with the new FTL ID `password-reset-forgot-heading`. The ID `password-reset-flow-heading` stays, because `AccountRecoveryConfirmKey`, `CompleteResetPassword`, and `ConfirmResetPassword` use it.
- Adds a body text (`password-reset-alternatives-body`). Its first sentence links to the email-first page with the current query string (`/${location.search}`, as `LinkRememberPassword` does).
- Adds small print below Continue (`password-reset-data-recovery-warning`) with a "Learn more" `LinkExternal` that opens the SUMO reset article in a new tab. Removes `password-reset-body-3`.
- Removes `LinkRememberPassword`, its `useWatch`, and the `showPasskeyOption` prop and container computation from this page only.
- Changes the `resetPasswordHeading` regex in the functional page object to `Forgot your password`. Adds `signInAlternativesLink` and the functional test "body link returns to the email-first page".
- Replaces the footer unit tests in `index.test.tsx` with tests for the new copy, the SUMO link, the missing footer, and the kept query params.

## Issue that this pull request solves

Closes: https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FXA-13258
